name: 47951-noadapterdecode-qwen332b-2gpu
hardware: 2x H100 80GB HBM3, two GPUs of one node, one allocation.
parallelism: TP=2, PP=1, DP=1 -- two ranks on one node; ~30.5 GiB of bf16 weights per rank.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=8, bounded at 320 requests / 1800 s safety, 5% warmup and 5% cooldown, both `mode: requests`.
workload: `synthetic_text`, single turn, no prefix buckets; prompt exactly 512 tokens and output exactly 128 (ignore_eos), unique Faker-generated English prompts, `request_format: plain`, `temperature: 0.0`, and no request attaches an adapter.
purpose: A 32-billion-parameter English writing assistant answering eight concurrent users with half-page prompts and short replies on two GPUs.
launch:
# The engine's launch arguments at commit cdab28319f5ea9521f93a31c7e5f14e4d2c194be.
# Anything not listed here is left at the engine's own default for this commit.

model: Qwen/Qwen3-32B

tensor-parallel-size: 2
pipeline-parallel-size: 1

# LoRA-capable with no `lora-modules`: LoRAConfig takes its own defaults at this commit.
enable-lora: true

enforce-eager: true
enable-prefix-caching: false

gpu-memory-utilization: 0.6
max-model-len: 2048
